content.title: Front Office Sports on Instagram: "Duke basketball twins Cameron and Cayden Boozer were born to save their older brother Carmani. Now they’re competing on the biggest stage in college basketball, chasing a national championship."
content.text: Duke basketball twins Cameron and Cayden Boozer were born to save their older brother Carmani. Now they’re competing on the biggest stage in college basketball, chasing a national championship.I KNEW THEY WAS MADE IN A LAB. THEY TOO GOOD BRONow that’s a positive modern science storyFamily over everything 💙Being born for spare parts is crazyThat’s beautiful and well done by the parents. No children suffered, just more love and more life. ❤️The mom is the real MVP!!!That's a hell of a bond for BrothersThat’s what a Mom does….anything to save their child. 🙏. Bravo Carlos 2. 🙏I didn’t know you could cure sickle cell that’s amazing !Nice story. Not available to just anyone. Try having a normal job and a 9-5 job that makes 100k trying to have insurance cover this. This would be a joke. Give me a kid from west side of Detroit story and the barriers he broke to be an icon would be better. Not some duke 5 Star basketball player that has been on the NBA radar since he was 12. That’s generational wealth right there.Like the plot of My Sister’s Keeper (2009). Great movie with Cameron Diaz, Alec Baldwin, and Abigail BresnanThat is literally the craziest shit I have ever heardThat’s actually pretty cool👏I’m glad it worked and to see where the twins have gone shows they are great parents.This is what money can do!They said NAAAAH we got this
